title: DLQ actions
description: Retry (same params), retry on different pool, delete/acknowledge. Batch actions for multiple selections.
definitionOfDone: Single-item actions: retry (same pool), retry on different pool (pool selector), delete/acknowledge
Batch actions toolbar: retry selected, delete selected
Confirmation dialog for batch actions showing count

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/dlq/DLQActions.tsx: Single-item action buttons (per row): Retry (outline button, calls useRetryDLQ with same pool), Retry on Different Pool (outline button, opens pool selector dropdown then calls useRetryDLQ with selected pool), Delete/Acknowledge (danger ghost button with ConfirmDialog). Batch action toolbar (appears when checkboxes selected): 'Retry Selected (N)' button with confirmation showing count, 'Delete Selected (N)' danger button with confirmation. Pool selector: Select component populated from available pools via useWorkers grouped by pool.
implementationPlan.note: Created DLQRowActions (retry/retry-different-pool/delete per row), DLQBatchToolbar (batch retry/delete with confirmations), PoolSelector modal, ConfirmDialog. Fixed require() to use normal ES imports.

implementationPlan.description: Integrate DLQActions into DLQPage.tsx — per-row actions and batch toolbar above table.
implementationPlan.note: Replaced inline BatchToolbar with DLQBatchToolbar (confirmation dialogs). Added DLQRowActions to each row with Actions column header. Removed unused batch hooks/handlers from page. Updated colSpan 6→7.
